sloka: स तदा सहसोत्पत्य राक्षसस्य महाहवे।मुष्टिं संवर्त्य वेगेन पातयामास वक्षसि ।। ६.९७.२५ ।।
transliteration: sa tadā sahasotpatya rākṣasasya mahāhave।muṣṭiṁ saṁvartya vegena pātayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 6.97.25 ।।

translations.english: Then in that great war, Sugriva getting up at once whirling his fist, hit (Virupaksha) him on the chest.
